stage.name: Enter Eternity
stage.description:
The footnotes of time have been removed, and the strife bears no fruit. Their war will continue on, but where will you go? 
This node will always be in a regular state and node type cannot be changed

Boss.name: Kharanduu Khagan, the Scourge of the Land

stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row

spawns.enemy: Kharanduu Khagan, the Scourge of the Land

enemyConfigurations.name: Kharanduu Khagan, the Scourge of the Land

khaganshadow.name: Khaganshadow
khaganshadow.flavourText: A soul trapped in the Khagan Nightzmora, which will raise its weapon and follow its eternal general to the ends of the land.

tiacauh_ripper.name: Tiacauh Ripper
tiacauh_ripper.flavourText: An extremely fervent Tiacauh warrior with very fast attack speed. Each strike now deals noteworthy damage, and those caught off guard will be quickly subdued by a rain of blows.
abilities: Every attack reduces the enemy's DEF

tiacauh_ritualist.name: Tiacauh Ritualist
tiacauh_ritualist.flavourText: The very few Originium Arts users in Acahualla will often serve as doctors for their tribe. Despite not developing their Originium Arts, their medical experience lets them strike where it hurts.
abilities: Gains DEF when blocked, and deals Physical damage with melee attacks.

royal_companion.name: Royal Companion
royal_companion.flavourText: The proud Beast Stewards have long had close ties to Sargon royalty, some even choosing to serve by a king's side as guardian.

elite_knight_shielder.name: Elite Knight Shielder
elite_knight_shielder.flavourText: An independent Kazimierz knight, with more expensive equipment, on the verge of finding a sponsor. In the ever-changing competition circuit, relying on defense to steadily rack up points is an effective strategy.

bloodboil_knightclub_elite.name: Bloodboil Knightclub Elite
bloodboil_knightclub_elite.flavourText: A regular knight from the Bloodboil Knightclub. The Bloodboil Knights have long been known for their ferocity and aggression, from trainees to knight nobles. Whenever one of their brothers falls, they gain courage and combat prowess.
abilities: Each time an enemy is defeated, gains ATK and ASPD, stacking up to 10 times.

tiacauh_champion.name: Tiacauh Champion
tiacauh_champion.flavourText: An incredibly formidable Tiacauh warrior, with the qualifications to become a Warchief. These warriors harbor great pride in their combat abilities, and live for the thrill of the duel no matter where they are. Their single-mindedness allows them to shrug off all outside interference.
abilities: When blocked, this unit will only receive damage from the unit blocking it, and the DEF of both units is decreased.

armorless_union_cleanup_squad.name: Armorless Union Cleanup Squad
armorless_union_cleanup_squad.flavourText: A member of the cleanup squad personally trained by Roy. Most of the time, Roy takes a hands-off attitude with the squad, so they have adopted some kind of bounty system and are often very thorough in their tasks. Their attacks inflict Corrosion.
abilities: After several attacks, the next attack deals more damage

armorless_union_third_squad.name: Armorless Union Third Squad
armorless_union_third_squad.flavourText: A member of the squad led by Monique. As a member handpicked by the Lazurite based on her preferences, they have a much higher wage. Their attacks inflict Corrosion.
abilities: After several attacks, the next attack deals more damage

kharanduu_khagan_the_scourge_of_the_land.name: Kharanduu Khagan, the Scourge of the Land
kharanduu_khagan_the_scourge_of_the_land.icon: /enemies-icons/Kharanduu Khagan, the Scourge of the Land.webp
kharanduu_khagan_the_scourge_of_the_land.flavourText: On the other side of time, the Khagan of the Nightzmora's Khaganquest comes to a close. Infinite wealth awaits his trampling heel on the golden coast.
abilities: When dealing damage, increases ATK and ASPD, up to a limit. This effect will reset a few seconds after this unit stops attacking
[Conquest] After charging up, deals heavy Physical damage to all units around <Lugalszargus, the Overlord of Ages> in a large area and inflicts Stun
When <Lugalszargus, the Overlord of Ages> is defeated or leaves, ASPD, Movement Speed, DEF, and RES are greatly increased, and your units become the target of [Conquest]

lugalszargus_the_overlord_of_ages.name: Lugalszargus, the Overlord of Ages
lugalszargus_the_overlord_of_ages.flavourText: On the other side of reality, 'The Shah of Past and Future' issues his edict. Life and death take up ranks alongside one another to fulfill Sargon's immense, monumental ambition.
abilities: When blocked, passes through the target, dealing Arts damage to the blocking unit
[Edict] After charging up, deals heavy Arts damage to all units around <Kharanduu Khagan, the Scourge of the Land> in a large area and inflicts Stun
When <Kharanduu Khagan, the Scourge of the Land> is defeated or leaves, ASPD, Movement Speed, DEF, and RES are greatly increased, and your units become the target of [Edict]
